meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 NanoClaw 群里搭建并维护一个持久 wiki:创建目录和初始文件,把维护规则写进群配置;收到资料时逐份处理,更新摘要、实体、概念、交叉引用、索引和日志。
howto.when: 当你说“add wiki”“wiki”等触发词,或要求给 NanoClaw 群加知识库时触发。

say.text: 给这个群加一个 wiki 知识库
say.note: Claude 会按步骤创建 wiki 目录和规则。

say.text: 把这份 PDF 放进 wiki
say.note: Claude 会先读它,再逐条更新 wiki 页面。

say.text: 每周做一次 wiki 健康检查
say.note: Claude 会询问并安排周期 lint 任务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude sets up and maintains a persistent wiki in a NanoClaw group: it creates folders and initial files, writes maintenance rules, then processes each submitted source one at a time, updating summaries, entities, concepts, cross-references, index, and log.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add wiki", "wiki", or similar keywords, or ask to add a knowledge base to a NanoClaw group.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group.
say_en.note: Claude will create the wiki folders and rules.

say_en.text: Put this PDF into the wiki.
say_en.note: Claude reads it first, then updates wiki pages one by one.

say_en.text: Run a weekly wiki health check.
say_en.note: Claude asks about schedule and sets up periodic lint.
